## About
Happy Feet Floors is a family owned business on West Main in League City. Our goal is to meet your individual flooring needs with personable customer service, one client at a time.
We carry a wide selection, from hardwood and carpet to porcelain tile, natural stone, luxury vinyl plank and granite and quartz countertops. Our skilled installers and management team take a personal interest in quality craftsmanship completed in a timely manner.
We couldn't have grown without the support of our customers, and we're grateful for a 4.4 rating from 21 Google reviews.

## Services
- Wood Flooring: Grain variation sets the style. Dramatic grain for a rustic look, moderate grain for traditional, and select hardwood with little color variation for a sleek, contemporary room.
- Carpet: Add visual interest with loop or pattern, and pick a carpet that goes with your favorite piece of furniture.
- Porcelain & Ceramic Tile: Durable in high-traffic rooms, easy to clean and scratch resistant, with designs from old-world style to sleek, ultramodern looks.
- Natural Stone: Each piece has its own color, texture and grain. Used for floors, walls, fireplaces and countertops, and it lasts virtually forever.
- Vinyl Plank & Laminate: Luxury vinyl tile (LVT) and luxury vinyl plank (LVP) look and feel like stone, ceramic or wood, and are often easier to install and maintain.
- Granite & Quartz Countertops: Stone countertops suit traditional, country or clean urban contemporary kitchens alike.
- Floor remodeling and bathroom overhauls: One customer hired us for floor remodeling and a large bathroom overhaul, and said Mike kept them updated the whole way.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you install the floors you sell?
A: Yes. Our skilled installers and management team work together on quality craftsmanship completed in a timely manner.

Q: How does your pricing compare?
A: One reviewer said our price was comparable to the big box stores, and another said our quote came in lower than competitors.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 2398 West Main in League City, TX. Come see us in person or call the office at 832-932-3984.
